chapter: Later career, civil service and jazz seminars
title: Trumpeter Bernard Flood
summary: Flood worked with Louie Armstrong's style, plays gigs and is about to retire from his government job; Dance remarks on a shortage of old-school trumpeters.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
